Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo: Cases Rise, Official Killed

The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 8,000 cases, with a death toll of 3,901. In a related development, mourners buried a DR Congo official who was killed after defending the Ebola response. Thousands of people have fled an Ebola-hit camp, raising concerns about the further spread of the disease.
